question: Who among the following is a 19th century exponent of the Kathak dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalka Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalka Prasad** is a 19th century exponent of the Kathak dance.
 
• Kalka Prasad was considered as the pillars of the **Lucknow Gharana**.
 
• Kalika Prasad Ji decided to live in Banaras and promoted **Kathak-style **dance and **Thumri** singing.
 
• He was responsible for promoting **Kathak** to a greater rank of art and beauty.
 
• Apart from dance, **tabla** and **pakhawaj** were the instrumental and expert singers, especially with a deep knowledge of Thumri.
 
• He was an expert in **Abhinaya** – expressing it in Thumri songs and performing Shringar Rasa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jatin Goswami **is an Indian dancer and choreographer, known as one of the prominent exponents of the classical dance form of Sattriya.
 
• **Sri** **Babhananda Barbayan** is dancer,choreographer, drummer, teacher and artistic-director. 
 
• **Krishna Panicker** is a famous Mohiniyattam dancer from the 20th century.
